# Qingdao Travel Guide (qingdao-shi-china.com)

> An independent, English-language travel guide to Qingdao (Qingdao Shi / 青岛市), Shandong, China — covering itineraries, weather, attractions, transport, food, hotels and the Tsingtao Brewery. Written and updated by travelers and residents; last refreshed August 2026.

## Key pages

- [Travel Guide](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-travel-guide/): Full planning guide with itineraries, budget and tips.
- [3-Day Itinerary](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-itineraries/3-days/): The classic first-visit day-by-day plan.
- [2-Day Itinerary](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-itineraries/2-days/): Weekend trip plan for Old Town and beaches.
- [5-Day Itinerary](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-itineraries/5-days/): In-depth trip including Laoshan and Huangdao.
- [Weather & Best Time to Visit](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-weather/): Monthly climate, sea temperature, AQI and packing guide.
- [Tsingtao Beer Guide](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-beer/): Brewery museum tour, beer street and Beer Festival.
- [FAQ](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/faq/): Visa, payment (Alipay/WeChat), VPN, safety and language questions.
- [First Hour Guide](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/first-hour/): Airport arrival step-by-step — immigration, SIM, Alipay, Didi.
- [Transportation](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-transportation/): Metro, bus, train and taxi practical info.
- [Routes](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-routes/): Walking, cycling, driving and photography routes.
- [About & Editorial Policy](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/about/): Who writes the guide, research methods, independence disclosure, contact.

## Attractions

- [Zhanqiao Pier](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-attractions/zhanqiao-pier/) — Qingdao's iconic 440m sea pier, free, open 24/7.
- [St. Michael's Cathedral](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-attractions/st-michaels-cathedral/) — Twin-spired 1934 German-era church.
- [Tsingtao Beer Museum](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-attractions/tsingtao-beer-museum/) — Original 1903 brewery with tastings.
- [Laoshan Mountain](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-attractions/laoshan-mountain/) — Sacred Taoist mountain on the coast.
- [Badaguan Scenic Area](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-attractions/badaguan/) — Tree-lined streets with 200+ German villas.
- [May Fourth Square](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-attractions/may-fourth-square/) — Modern civic center and skyline views.
- [Olympic Sailing Center](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-attractions/olympic-sailing-center/) — 2008 Olympic marina, sunset spot.
- [Golden Beach](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-attractions/golden-beach/) — 3.5km of fine sand in Huangdao.
- [Silver Beach](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-attractions/silver-beach/) — Quieter neighbor of Golden Beach.
- [Qingdao TV Tower](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-attractions/qingdao-tv-tower/) — 232m observation deck, glass floor.
- [Xiaoyushan Park](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-attractions/xiaoyushan-park/) — Best panoramic Old Town viewpoint.
- [Underwater World](https://www.qingdao-shi-china.com/qingdao-attractions/underwater-world/) — China's first aquarium (1932).
